scheme_name: Group Insurance Scheme for Powerloom Weavers
other_conditions: Eligibility is limited to families of powerloom workers engaged in weaving on powerlooms and allied pre‑weaving activities such as twisting, winding, warping and sizing.
Self‑employed weaver families owning not more than 4 looms are eligible.
The beneficiary and his/her spouse constitute the family unit, and only one of them may be covered under the scheme.
Coverage is valid for one year per premium payment and can be renewed annually up to the age of 59.
benefits_summary: Provides a sum assured of ₹60,000 for natural death, ₹1,50,000 for death or total disability due to accident, ₹75,000 for partial disability, and an educational grant of ₹600 per child per half‑year for up to four years.
